messages.author: b5121561aa707d54
messages.subject: user-specified prior with argument target= "stanclassic" option
parts:
I need to change default prior when running a Bayesian SEM in blavaan (specifically speaking, I'd like to change the prior of regression parameter beta from normal distribution to Beta distribution). I'm hoping to stay away from having to specify each parameter separately with the prior() function, since our model is a bit complicated.

From this link, http://ecmerkle.github.io/blavaan/articles/prior.html, it seems to be the key to opening up more flexibility in prior specification with argument target= "stanclassic" option, but it doesn't seem to work when we try including it in the syntax. We don't get an error message, but the model just won't fully run. We keep it going almost all day and still it doesn't give me any output. It's as if it kills the kernel.

I have searched for a solution for a long time but no finding. Any ideas for this would be appreciated.

Thanks,
Sixue

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: user-specified prior with argument target= "stanclassic" option
parts:
Sixue

This example worked with the example from the bsem function, using the beta() for priors for regressions.
If you can share more details we can see where any specific error ir

library(blavaan)

?bsem


model <- '
  # latent variable definitions
     ind60 =~ x1 + x2 + x3
     dem60 =~ y1 + a*y2 + b*y3 + c*y4
     dem65 =~ y5 + a*y6 + b*y7 + c*y8

  # regressions
    dem60 ~ ind60
    dem65 ~ ind60 + dem60

  # residual correlations
    y1 ~~ y5
    y2 ~~ y4 + y6
    y3 ~~ y7
    y4 ~~ y8
    y6 ~~ y8
'

## unique priors for mv intercepts; parallel chains
fit <- bsem(model, data=PoliticalDemocracy, std.lv=T,
            dp=dpriors(beta="beta(1,1)"),
            target="stanclassic")
summary(fit)
